name: Rope Net Trap

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-09: Equal Exchange - Skymetal Hoard

disable: DC 14 Thievery check to cut the triggering length of rope

items.name: Ensnare
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on top of where the trap is located

---

Effect The triggering creature is caught in the rope net. The target must attempt a DC 20 Reflex save save or be Immobilized in the net and suspended in the air until they Escape from the net.

text: This trap is a net weaved from rope laid out beneath the jungle underbrush with mechanisms attached to some nearby trees; when triggered, it cases the target in the net and suspends them indefinitely.
